name: knowledge-base
summary: Organization knowledge articles with full-text and substring search.
description: Adds a knowledge starter: organization owners and admins write Markdown articles, every member reads and searches them. Search ranks full-text matches and also finds substrings, so it works for languages written without spaces, such as Chinese. Writes use optimistic concurrency (If-Match) and record audit changes without article text.
use_when: the team needs a knowledge base, wiki, FAQ, or help center
members must search shared documents, including Chinese text
a later AI feature needs a store of organization documents to answer from
